items.title: New electricity prices take effect
items.quote: zum 01.01.2027 passen wir die Preise in Ihrem Tarif „Region Basis“ an.
items.computation: The letter states the new prices (Arbeitspreis, Grundpreis, Abschlag) apply from the calendar date given in the letter, 01.01.2027. No counting rule needed; this is a stated calendar date.

items.title: Special right to cancel contract due to price increase
items.quote: Ihre Kündigung muss uns vor diesem Tag in Textform erreichen; Kosten entstehen Ihnen dadurch nicht.
items.computation: The provider grants a special termination right effective 01.01.2027 because of the price change. The cancellation must reach the provider 'vor diesem Tag', i.e. before 01.01.2027. The last day on which it can still arrive is therefore the day before, 31.12.2026. This is a fixed cut-off tied to the stated effective date, not a statutory period subject to §193 BGB weekend/holiday extension, and in any case 31.12.2026 is a Thursday (not a Saturday, Sunday, or public holiday in NW), so no adjustment is needed.
